moves.wide: whole subject and surroundings, camera far
moves.medium: subject from the waist up, neutral distance
moves.push_in: camera glides toward the subject over the shot
moves.pull_out: camera glides away from the subject over the shot
moves.slow_push: very slow push toward a face at an emotional moment (0.3-0.6 m)
moves.truck: camera slides sideways past the subject
moves.arc: camera circles the subject by 15-40 degrees
moves.crane_up: camera rises and backs away, scene finale
moves.crane_down: camera descends and moves in, scene entrance
moves.follow_side: camera walks beside a walking actor
moves.follow_behind: camera follows a walking actor from behind
moves.lead: camera backs away in front of a walking actor
moves.drift: tiny 5-15 cm drift, a living still shot
moves.steadicam: smooth floating camera, almost no shake
moves.dolly_zoom: Vertigo effect: camera and lens move opposite, subject size constant
moves.pan_to: camera turns from one actor to another without moving
moves.tilt_up: camera turns up along the figure
moves.whip_pan: fast pan used as a cut
moves.low: camera below eye level looking up
moves.tatami: Ozu tatami shot: camera 0.6-0.8 m, no movement
moves.profile: side view of the face, azimuth 80-100 degrees
moves.three_quarter: three-quarter view of the face, azimuth 30-50 degrees
moves.detail: close detail of a hand or an object
moves.two: two-shot with both actors in frame
moves.close_reaction: close shot of the listener reacting

schemes.over_the_shoulder: shot / reverse shot, over the shoulder in turn
schemes.reaction_cut: close shot of the listener's reaction
schemes.establishing: wide establishing shot at the scene start
schemes.oner: one long take that chains moves without a cut
schemes.return_wide: return to the wide shot at the end of a line
schemes.open_from_light: open on a window or light, then on the hero
schemes.final_pull_out: last shot of the scene pulls out

records.insert: insert of an object (record only, not executed)
records.pov: point of view of an actor (record only, not executed)
records.cross_cut: cross-cutting between two places (record only, not executed)
